description: Wire framing and auth handshake for the Programa v2 socket protocol. See docs/v2-api-migration.md and Sources/TerminalController.swift (processV2Command).

transport.framing: One JSON object per line (newline-delimited). Multi-line JSON is not supported; the server collapses embedded newlines in its own responses. The v1 line-based protocol has been removed: any line not starting with '{' gets a terse 'v1_removed' error instead of a parse failure.

id.description: Client-chosen correlation id, echoed back verbatim (any JSON value, or omitted/null).

method.description: One of the method names in methods.json. Required, non-empty.

params.description: Method-specific parameters. Omitted params default to an empty object.

common_error_codes.v1_removed: Line did not start with '{' — the removed v1 protocol was used.
common_error_codes.invalid_utf8: Request bytes were not valid UTF-8.
common_error_codes.parse_error: Request line was not valid JSON.
common_error_codes.invalid_request: Top-level JSON was not an object, or params was present but not an object, or method was missing/empty.
common_error_codes.auth_required: Socket is in password-auth mode and this connection has not authenticated yet. Send auth.login first.
common_error_codes.auth_failed: auth.login was called with an incorrect password.
common_error_codes.invalid_params: Method-specific: a required param was missing or the wrong type.
common_error_codes.not_found: Method-specific: a referenced window/workspace/pane/surface/etc. does not exist.
common_error_codes.unavailable: Method-specific: the app or a required subsystem is not in a state to handle the request.
common_error_codes.encode_error: Server failed to encode its own JSON response (should not happen).

auth_handshake.description: Auth is a socket-wide, connection-scoped gate, not per-method. When the listening socket's access mode requires a password (SocketRequestPolicy.requiresPasswordAuthentication), every method except auth.login returns error code 'auth_required' until that connection sends a successful auth.login. Unauthenticated connections are otherwise indistinguishable from authenticated ones at the framing level.
steps: Connect to the unix socket at the app-reported socket path.
If the socket is not in password mode, send any method directly — no handshake needed.
If the socket is in password mode, send {"method":"auth.login","params":{"password":"..."}} first.

A successful auth.login returns {"ok":true,"result":{"authenticated":true}}; the connection is now authenticated for its lifetime (or until the server's authCredentialEpoch changes, e.g. the password was rotated in Settings, which forces re-auth).
auth.login with a missing password returns invalid_params; with a wrong password returns auth_failed; any other method sent before a successful login returns auth_required.

handle_refs.description: Most id-shaped params (window_id, workspace_id, pane_id, surface_id, tab_id) accept either a raw UUID or a short opaque handle-ref of the form '<kind>:<N>' (e.g. 'workspace:3'), minted by the server the first time an object is returned to a client and stable for that object's lifetime. Refs are never reissued for a new object even after the original is pruned.

capabilities.description: system.capabilities returns the method set advertised for the current build configuration (base methods always; debug methods only in DEBUG builds). It must equal the contract's method set filtered the same way — see tests_v2/test_v2_contract_matches_capabilities.py.
